changeSet.author: stone-shelter
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE outbox_event ( event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, delivery_state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', CONSTRAINT outbox_event_type_nonblank CHECK (event_type ~ '[^[:space:]]'), CONSTRAINT outbox_event_schema_version_positive CHECK (schema_version > 0), CONSTRAINT outbox_event_payload_object CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object' AND payload <> '{}'::jsonb), CONSTRAINT outbox_event_delivery_state_valid CHECK (delivery_state = 'PENDING') );
